## Source and method

One row per dated ecosystem event tracked on https://aifitnessapi.com/changes — deprecations, deadlines, term changes, model freezes. The status field is the point of the dataset: confirmed means a vendor's own words are quoted on the linked page; reported means vendor or community notices we could not confirm on an official page; watch means an undated live risk. Date precision is kept exactly as sourced ("2026-09" means a reported month) and is never sharpened. Every row links the page on this site that carries the sourced claim, and verifiedOn records when that page was last checked. The undated watch items published on /changes are excluded here because they carry no date to publish.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | Event date at the precision the source supports (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `sortDate` | Full ISO date used only for ordering when `date` is fuzzy | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `title` | Short name of the event | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `summary` | What changed, in the words the linked page can support | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `status` | confirmed \| reported \| watch — the evidence grade, see methodology | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `source` | aifitnessapi.com page carrying the sourced claim | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `sourceLabel` | Title of that page | string | 0 of 22 rows |
| `verifiedOn` | Date this entry was last checked against its source page | string | 0 of 22 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/changes.ts` is maintained by hand alongside the pages it feeds; this dataset is regenerated from it with `npm run datasets` in the change that edits it, so it moves when the site's pages move.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
